hints.tr: Çıkış parametresi tanımda `OUTPUT` ile işaretleniyor: `@order_count INT OUTPUT`. Değeri atamak için `SELECT @order_count = COUNT(*) FROM ...` — bu bir sonuç tablosu döndürmüyor.
hints.en: An output parameter is marked with `OUTPUT` in the definition: `@order_count INT OUTPUT`. To set its value, `SELECT @order_count = COUNT(*) FROM ...` — this returns no result table.

hints.tr: İsteğe bağlı parametre bir varsayılan değerle yazılıyor: `@status NVARCHAR(20) = NULL`. "Verilmediyse hepsi" koşulu: `(@status IS NULL OR status = @status)`.
hints.en: An optional parameter is written with a default value: `@status NVARCHAR(20) = NULL`. The "if not given, all of them" condition: `(@status IS NULL OR status = @status)`.

checks.query: SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @all INT, @shipped INT, @none INT; EXEC dbo.customer_order_count 1, @all OUTPUT; EXEC dbo.customer_order_count @customer_id = 1, @order_count = @shipped OUTPUT, @status = N'shipped'; EXEC dbo.customer_order_count 6, @none OUTPUT; SELECT @all AS all_orders, @shipped AS shipped_orders, @none AS no_orders;
